name: Attributed Notes
job: Record what a counterpart said about themselves in panels, each line timestamped and marked as their words, with unverified figures rendered in grain.

anatomy.role: Elevated card, one topic a panel; panels sit in an auto-fit grid of 18rem columns
Topic in mono caps (h3), and the source line: His words, unverified
A bold lead phrase, then the note in their words
Where in the transcript, right aligned from a 22rem panel
37 `grain` on the line: a number they gave that nobody checked

states.name: Plain
states.note: Their words, each with a timestamp.

states.name: Unverified figure
states.note: A number they gave, in grain, labelled as theirs.

use_when: Background a counterpart gave about themselves, kept apart from what was checked.
A recap where attribution matters: who said it, when.
avoid_when: Do not put a sensitive personal fact in a note, even in their words; leave it out of the page.
Do not present an unverified figure in sharp type.
Do not mix the author's reading into a panel; that is 57 Ledger row.
access: Each panel is a heading and a list, so a screen reader announces the topic and the count.
Unverified is said in words in the source line and in the text; grain repeats it.

used_by.name: Recoil: Zach x Brian, 2026-11-11 (_ARTIFACTS/recoil-brian-2026-11-11.html), template recoil-skim

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it line for line.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000.
